collection.title: Škoda Superb Estate 2015 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Superb Estate 2015 - 2024 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Skoda Superb which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
